title: File:Rack with varoius servers.jpg
desc: Most every data center has a rack where the random stuff goes. This is ours. These are the SCCM server (and database storage), our three spam firewalls, two or three app-specific systems, one requiring a dongle(!), the Mac servers, and video storage for the Athletics department.
